chapter: Chicago, the Marable boats and Marge's St. Louis family band
title: Creath hears Zutty, who returns to St. Louis and joins him
summary: Creath came back from the Derby raving about a drummer called Singleton, to the annoyance of his drummers. Zutty went home to New Orleans, missed Marge and joined Creath for about a year and a half.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Well, when you get there, Zutty, now when do you sort of -- do you -- you come into Charlie Creath's band.
Yeah.
Because when Charlie came back, he told me at that time we had Willie Woods and we had Billie Lewis, and --
And Ralph Stevens.
On drums. We had about three drummers.
I see.
For these different bands.

And when Charlie came back from the Derby he said, Maude, I heard the drummingest son of a bitch I ever heard in my life. I said, yeah, because he cursed every other word was a curse word. If it was just general conversation. And he said he's coming to St. Louis with Maude Belle's Fate Maribel's band. He said, and he is the type of drummer I've always looked for and wanted to hear. He said he is a drummer, talk about a drummer, and he said I invited him to come by and I want him to hear my bands too, and all. Oh, the drummers got mad. Oh, they were really mad for Charlie talking about the ways that Zutty he could play. He says, his name is Selton, Singleton,
because he never did call Zutty Zutty, he called him Singleton all the time.
Oh, I see.
Oh, yes, Singleton. Said his name is Singleton. He can drum. So he came by, and he was with Fate Marable's band.
Well, how did you get him away from Fate Marible?
Oh, well, he went back to New Orleans.
I went back to New Orleans, and I missed Marge so much --
Ahh.
And so Charlie said he'd give him a job.
Yeah.
And he sent for him.
Another reason is John Charlie Creath's band. Creath is back.
And we were corresponding and Zutty said he just didn't like New Orleans, he just wanted come back to St. Louis. And I told Charlie, Charlie said tell him to come on, I'll give him a job. Any day.
And how long did you work with Charlie, then?
Oh, about a year and a half.
Year and a half, yeah.
Something like that. And that's when we went to Chicago.
